items.summary: Its key temperature goal has been missed but experts say the agreement is still proving a vital moral compass for progress It was a curious way of conducting negotiations. Ahead of the 2025 climate summit, in the Amazonian port of Belém last year, the Brazilian hosts had taken off the table the issue that most had assumed would be at its heart: concrete plans from each country laying out exactly what they would be doing to cut their greenhouse gas emissions. Brazil was insisting, instead, that these plans – the bedrock of the Paris agreement – were the business of national governments and not up for negotiation. “In that case, it will be a very short Cop,” one seasoned global south negotiator told the Guardian shortly before, reflecting a widespread unease. “There is nothing to negotiate.” Continue reading...

Nine British nationals were among the 15 people who died when fire ripped through the village of Bédar this summer. Relatives of Britons killed in this summer's wildfires in Spain have told the BBC they are disgusted, after regional politicians blocked an official inquiry into the disaster. Families have criticised the authorities' actions, including the decision not to send an emergency alert to mobile phones as the flames closed in. "If that evacuation warning had come through in time, my father would still be alive," says Duncan Chard, who blames failures by officials on the day for a number of the deaths.

Observations and other notes of interest from Thursday night’s 120-100 loss to the Golden State Warriors: – As Klay Thompson spoke about the Heat having won three of four in the wake of Wednesday night’s victory over the Clippers, it felt a bit hollow. – Only so much could be taken from success against the middling Hawks, the shorthanded Pacers and the slumping Clippers. – In that regard, that ... – Even against a team forecast just to battle for the play-in in the Western Conference, the Heat couldn't muster enough on the second night of the back-to-back.

Twenty-four hours earlier, Miami Heat coach Erik Spoelstra was talking karma, after his team battled back from 20 down to an overtime victory over the Los Angeles Clippers. A day later, the Heat learned that karma can be a switch, one easily flipped back the other way when the defense isn’t there and the offense is uneven. So from the euphoria of Klay Thompson’s game-winning 3-pointer a night ... So from the euphoria of Klay Thompson's game-winning 3-pointer a night earlier in Los Angeles, it was down, way down, by the Bay for the Heat in a 120-100 loss Thursday night to the Golden State Warriors at Chase Center in San Francisco.

LIV Golf will shut down after failing to secure financial backing for its future, the previously Saudi-financed golf league announced Thursday. The league, which rivaled the PGA Tour and launched in 2021, proceeded through a harsh climate throughout its five seasons. What is the Nations Championship, who is winning and who plays who this weekend? After three rounds of home games for southern hemisphere nations in July, the northern hemisphere teams are the hosts for the final three rounds. Six Nations champions France, who play Fiji on Saturday, head the standings in the north with 12 points, and as things stand would play world champions South Africa in the inaugural final at Allianz Stadium on 29 November. Certain configurations of Alpine are affected. Other distros may be as well. The vulnerability exists in the interaction between OpenSSH, the code library implementing SSH connections, and musl, a lightweight alternative to the libc library that, unlike most other Linux distributions, is used in Alpine. Further, OpenSSH using musl (pronounced muscle) must not use PAM (pluggable authentication modules), a framework that handles user authentication and account-access checks. Alpine is a lightweight, widely used Linux distribution. Other platforms may be affected if they use the same configurations.

Explaining the Great Unconformity, where Cambrian deposits sit on top of older rocks. In a recent Nature study, Flament and his colleague Santosh Dhungana argue that this gap was carved with help from deep within the planet. According to their models, slow currents of hot rock in Earth’s mantle pushed entire continents up for hundreds of millions of years, letting glaciers grind them down and then let them sink, allowing fresh sediments to bury the scar. The largest hole in the rock record might be a fingerprint of processes happening deep in the planet’s interior.

Only 17 of the top 100 players in the 2027 draft class are set to have their eligibility expire Five-for-five plays out exactly how you think. College players have five years of service available to them before they've exhausted their NCAA eligibility, no matter whether they took a redshirt year or not. What this means is that true seniors, players who got on the field for four years without burning a redshirt, are no longer getting pushed out of the NCAA, but actually have another year of eligibility. I first got wind of this upcoming trend in October, so I decided to look at the upcoming class and how it would impact it. My finding: It could impact it a lot.

It's the exact path, not the apparent severity that matters most, doctors say. Despite the ghastly injury, the man was alive and conscious when he arrived. Men's college soccer won't be a two-semester sport after all following a vote of Division I schools. Two-thirds of Division I schools rescinded a previously approved rule change to college soccer's calendar, the NCAA announced Friday, Nov. 6. The rule change would've moved the men's college soccer national championship to the spring semester; now, it will remain during the fall. The sport's oversight committee had previously adopted the rule change in May. Men's college soccer moving to a two-semester sport was also recommended by U.S. Soccer, the highest governing body in the country.

With UK interest rates set to rise, mortgages, credit cards and loans could get more expensive for millions. The Leonid meteor shower, known for its bright and fast meteors, will kick off this weekend and continue until the end of November. The Leonid meteor shower is set to dazzle sky gazers across the UK throughout November. The celestial spectacle takes place from now until 30 November with the peak taking place on the night of 17 November. The shower is made up of dust particles from the Comet 55P/Tempel-Tuttle, which leaves a trail of debris as it follows its path around the Sun. These particles enter the Earth's atmosphere at up to 44 miles (71km) per second - meaning these streaks of light are the fastest meteors in the sky.

Wondering how rain-affected matches are decided in cricket? How the DLS method works in ODIs and T20Is, and how targets are adjusted fairly when weather interrupts play. The DLS method is used to determine fair targets in rain-affected limited-overs matches. The method is exclusively applied to limited-overs formats like ODIs and T20Is and is not used in Test cricket. Many matches, including World Cup games, have been decided by the DLS method, occasionally leading to significant debate. The method's name is derived from its creators Frank Duckworth and Tony Lewis, including the updated inputs from Steven Stern. Which is how the name, Duckworth-Lewis-Stern (DLS) method was coined.

Manchester United’s plans to bolster their left-back position in January appear to have taken an optimistic turn. The Red Devils are ruing their decision to end the summer transfer window without si... Luke Shaw's injury troubles this season, coupled with Patrick Dorgu's fitness issues, have hurt the club, who are now 17th in the Premier League after nine games. The situation calls for immediate action, and all signs indicate that INEOS will address the position at the turn of the year. A recent report relayed by The Peoples Person has named David Raum among the candidates on United's wish list. The German was also eyed by the English giants this summer, but a move failed to materialise.

Brandon Miller left Friday's game with a groin injury just after signing a record contract. Here is what the Hornets' coach said about his status. Miller scored eight points early on but started walking gingerly after an alley-oop play in the first quarter. He eventually left the game midway through the second quarter while the Hornets trailed 47-23. Head coach Charles Lee admitted the signs were clear before the substitution. "To be honest, I saw him start to limp a couple of plays. He was good, then he asked for a sub. We'll evaluate him over the weekend, and we'll have more information on Monday," Lee said.

Lee Westwood says the DP World Tour lost its leverage with LIV gone. He urges the PGA Tour to play hardball and demand more for future funding. For years, LIV players could not touch PGA Tour events but could still play on the DP World Tour. This rule gave the European circuit a unique advantage in talks with the Americans. Westwood noted that this setup gave them some "leverage" while the rival tour was still active. The 53-year-old explained the situation clearly in his interview with BBC Sport. "LIV going out of business, some people will be disappointed and it might not be people that you immediately think of," Westwood said. He added that "The European tour, I'm not sure it's such a…

Joe Milton breaks his silence on becoming the Eagles starter. Learn how Nick Sirianni tried to hide the QB change from the Giants until the last minute. Sirianni explained his reasoning during a Friday press conference. He noted that every second spent hiding the move gives the opponent less time to prepare. "I was going to hold onto that for as long as I possibly could," Sirianni said. He emphasized that his main job is to win games and protect the players on the roster. This approach fits a pattern where the coach has used information to create a competitive edge in the past.

The U.S. men’s national team will add midfielder Jack McGlynn to its roster for the upcoming CONCACAF Nations League matches against Haiti. Replacing Reyna is McGlynn, the Stoke City midfielder, who made a significant impact for the USMNT during the 2025 CONCACAF Gold Cup, featuring in all six matches of the tournament. Over the course of his 13 appearances for the senior national team, McGlynn has contributed two goals and two assists. Reyna injury came after he netted Strasbourg's only goal in the 67th minute of their 3-1 defeat on Nov. 6. Shortly after scoring, he signaled to the bench that he was experiencing discomfort in his thigh and requested a substitution. After being subbed off,…

Devin Singletary proved his patience with a game-winning touchdown. His professionalism kept him ready when injuries struck the Giants backfield. Injuries cleared the path for the 29-year-old veteran when Tyrone Tracy landed on injured reserve with a hamstring issue. Cam Skattebo also hurt his hamstring right before the big play that sealed the win. Singletary was the only healthy back left to take the handoff from quarterback J.J. McCarthy. He broke free for a 30-yard run to end the game with 7:25 left in overtime. The Giants won 27-21 thanks to that single play.

The Nashville Predators debuted their Hometown Remix jerseys on Nov. 7, plus they added 'Dolly' nameplates during warmups to honor Dolly Parton. During warmups before their matchup with the St. Louis Blues on Nov. 7, every member of the Nashville Predators wore "Dolly" on their nameplates to honor the country music legend. The nod to Parton, who died on Aug. 25, is part of the Predators' Hometown Remix alternate jersey , which was revealed on Nov. 2. The jerseys include gold trim and design elements symbolizing "heritage rodeo-tailoring flair" and "a modern take on country roots, showmanship, and Preds pride."

Kimmich believes the recent shows of strength against adversity demonstrate real team spirit. From presidents who end up in jail to players burning down their houses, constant public sniping, regular infighting, and frequent coaching changes, unrest and tension amid success have long been the norm for Die Rekordmeister . In some ways, that instability has been the bedrock of the Bavarians' success, as the club has never grown comfortable enough to rest on its laurels or lower its very high standards. However, stability is also vital in building a club to greater heights. Drama remains at the core and will never truly go away as long as the club maintains its high standards, but the last few…

The new NBA season has barely started, and the injury list is already painfully long. Tyrese Haliburton and Jalen Williams all are down with injuries. But now 4-time champion Draymond Green has a strong opinion on what it means for the Minnesota Timberwolves. During the recent episode of "The Draymond Green Show," Green pointed out that Edwards' injury could leave the Timberwolves in a vulnerable position when negotiating his next contract. "I'll tell you who this sucks for more than anyone. This puts the Minnesota Timberwolves in a vulnerable position. Minnesota being his team with his bird rights, they have less leverage to make him stay because he don't qualify for the Supermax."

Missouri football defensive end Langden Kitchen had to be helped off the field during the first quarter of MU's game against Texas. After tackling Longhorns wide receiver Ryan Wingo on a first-down play near midfield, Kitchen sprang up and immediately clutched the back of his left leg and went back down to the field. He appeared to be in a significant amount of pain, and Missouri trainers were with him on the field for several minutes after the injury. Kitchen was helped off the field and did not appear to be able to put any weight on the injured leg.

FC Bayern’s manager will be back as early as this month "We're very hopeful. We'd all be delighted if he could return as soon as possible. But that's for the coach to decide," Pavlović said after a 2-1 win over Mainz (via @iMiaSanMia ). "He should take as much time as he needs. Obviously, we'll be very happy when he's back." When asked whether he had seen the coach during his recovery, the 22-year-old midfielder said he "saw him briefly once. That was about it." Kompany was last seen in the dugout against Arsenal on October 16. In the meantime, Danks has done a solid job deputizing for Kompany by maintaining the team's unbeaten run.

Golden State Warriors legend Chris Mullin had high praise for rookie Yaxel Lendeborg in a recent interview. "If the Warriors win enough games, he'll be in All-Star consideration for sure. And I think he's going to be a perennial All-Star and just an All-NBA type performer moving forward consistently,"…

(Dub, Chet, Caso) era started with a 124-97 win over the Memphis Grizzlies . The butt-whooping was part of the 2026 NBA Cup West Group B stage. It was somewhat surprising to see Roberto de Zerbi take a more peaceful approach when he faced the media at Elland Road after Tottenham's 1-0 defeat by Leeds United on Saturday afternoon. The Spurs manager had been expected to come out swinging in the direction of the officials after his side's first Premier League loss since September, with much of the focus falling on referee John Brooks' decision not to send Jayden Bogle off for a late challenge on Mathys Tel during the first half. It was a decision that no doubt impacted the game - and perhaps Tottenham's chances of earning a fourth consecutive Premier League victory for the first time since October 2023.

Tiger Woods turned down a reported $750 million to join LIV Golf, a decision that looks brilliant as the league files for bankruptcy and abandons its future plans. The collapse of the LIV Golf project was confirmed during a bankruptcy hearing in New Jersey on Thursday. Gibson Dunn's Attorney Matthew Williams informed the court that the league failed to secure an agreement capable of enabling financially sustainable restructuring. Williams stated, "The debtors are not currently proceeding with the LIV 2.0 plan," marking the end of any hopes for a scaled-down revival, according to Yahoo Sports . William Saliba’s absence from Arsenal’s matchday squad against Hull City this afternoon has raised questions, particularly after the Frenchman appeared to be closing in on his long-awaited return.... The 25-year-old has yet to feature competitively this season following the back injury sustained during the summer's World Cup, but there had been encouraging signs of progress. Saliba returned to training last week and was named among the substitutes for Wednesday's Champions League victory over Slavia Prague, although he remained on the bench.

Here’s how the Wildcats can overcome Maryland once again and win a Big Ten tournament championship But with so much pressure on this team to win the Big Ten and then the Natty, the Wildcats can't get too far ahead of themselves. And though they beat the Terrapins 4-2 in their regular-season matchup, that game was far closer than the score would suggest, with Maryland leading for almost a third of the game. While the Terrapins have owned the historic matchup between these two teams, Northwestern is 6-1 in this matchup over the last 25 years at neutral sites such as Columbus, where this game will be played.

Johnna Rossbach, Mixly's co-founder, developed a mixer for non-alcoholic drinks, dirty sodas and more through hand-squeezing fruit, funding her own project and a lot of hard work. Mixly's mixers aren't just for cocktails. The unique flavors are in dirty sodas, marinades and more. (Mixly Beverage Co) Johnna Rossbach never expected to become an entrepreneur. After spending 15 years in a career that left little room for creativity, she found the motivation to build something of her own after becoming a mother. "I wanted to show my daughters what it looks like to be empowered, and that if you’re not happy with something, change it," Rossbach said.

Luka Doncic called out his mentor Dirk Nowitzki on Friday, saying the legend won't even call him. See the stats behind the playful jab. Doncic was asked about Nowitzki ahead of the matchup against the Portland Trail Blazers. The former NBA champion has been praising the superstar on the Amazon Prime broadcast crew. When the question came up, Doncic did not hold back his feelings about the lack of contact. "He don't even call. He's in LA and he don't even call no more, so I expect that dinner soon," Doncic said. "I expect that call."

Nick Young says all Giannis Antetokounmpo wants to do is go coast to coast. Rivers said Antetokounmpo isn't easy to coach, doesn't have a high IQ, and only has one way to play . While some have to the two-time MVP's defense , former NBA player Nick Young went off on him on Gil's Arena . "The n***a dumb, that's all," Young said. "He just Gyro Greek brain, that's all… All he learned was to go coast to coast. The n***a ain't changed. I haven't seen a jump shot. The n***a been going coast to coast since he came in the league."

Beginning with former No. 3 overall pick Jayson Tatum, who helped dismantle the Charlotte Hornets , scoring a game-high 34 points, 18 of which came in the first quarter, to go along with eight rebounds and nine assists. WWE Crown Jewel 2026 results as Cody Rhodes defeats Randy Orton in a Last Man Standing Match to become No. 1 contender. The two future Hall of Famers have spent the past 10 months on-and-off at odds with one another. En route to WrestleMania 42 back in April, Orton and Rhodes battled over the prestigious WWE Championship, but that feud, expected to be epic, was marred by the inclusion of Pat McAfee . After a post-WrestleMania hiatus, Orton returned at WWE SummerSlam to rekindle the rivalry, and after months of going back and forth, it all led to Crown Jewel 2026 and a match build around the question: will Rhodes punt kick Orton into oblivion?

James Pearce Jr. downgraded to questionable ahead of Week 9 game vs. Bengals While the Falcons are banged up along their front seven, there's a chance they will get their top pass rusher back in time for Week 9. James Pearce Jr . is eligible to play after completing his eight-game suspension, however, the former first-round pick's back flared up during Friday's practice in Madrid. Head coach Kevin Stefanski said the team would monitor Pearce's status over the weekend but officially downgraded his status to questionable for Sunday's game. Since the Falcons were planning to ease Pearce back in on pass-rushing downs, there's a good chance that they will opt to keep him sidelined in Week 9.

ESPN "College GameDay" host Kirk Herbstreit explains why Georgia will snap Ole Miss' 16-game home winning streak Herbstreit picked Georgia to beat Ole Miss. He explained why he thinks the Dawgs will win to get revenge for losing to Ole Miss and quarterback Trinidad Chambliss in the Sugar Bowl last season. "Ole Miss has won 16 games in a row at home," Herbstreit said. The Rebels have not lost at home since falling to Kentucky in 2024. Chambliss is undefeated at home. "I think Gunner Stockton wins this game," Herbstreit continued. "Lots of short, quick passes, get the ball out of his hands."

Carmel secured its 33rd sectional title by edging out Hamilton Southeastern 17-14 in a hard-fought football game. The Carmel offense was run by Mychael Lewis, Jackson Treadway, and Josiah Gilmore, who combined for 341 yards. Lewis had 175 rushing yards and one touchdown before leaving in the fourth quarter with an injury. "Let's take it one day at a time," Carmel coach Kevin Wright said when asked about his message to the team. "Do everything we can do, control what we can control and find a way to win the game." Carter Reed took a handoff, then pitched to Karson Kelly, who pitched to Deaken Johnson. Johnson let a 28-pass fly to a wide-open Kaiden Anthony to tie the score.

Adam Schefter reveals A.J. Brown's knee concerns scared off other teams before the trade. Fans now fear he won't play again this season. Adam Schefter reported that the injury report lists both an ankle and a knee, but the knee is the real problem. "It flared up…I know it says ankle and knee, but it's the knee," Schefter said, according to the New York Post . The issue kept him out last week and now threatens his return for the Sunday game against the Green Bay Packers. He has played only 30 snaps since joining New England.

Matt Rhule's contract extension added a massive $63 million buyout. Nebraska fans learn the real price tag to move on from their coach after a rough season. Near the conclusion of his third season in the role, Rhule signed the extension. The contract now runs through the 2032 season. According to reports, the buyout number sits at $63 million. That sum is 90% guaranteed, which means the school owes almost the entire amount if they let him go. The deal was designed to keep Rhule from returning to his alma mater, Penn State, after James Franklin parted ways there.

The Bears are eyeing a two-player trade with the Jets for Nahshon Wright and Will McDonald IV. Wright says he is frustrated with his role in New York. NFL insider Ian Rapoport reported on Tuesday, November 3, that Chicago remains active in talks to improve its defensive unit. Rapoport noted that the team has a clear need on the edge and might also seek help in the secondary. "Among their needs, they have a need on the edge, and I wouldn't be surprised to see them add some secondary help as well," Rapoport said. The insider believes general manager Ryan Poles is not done building the roster.

The Ally Tipoff returns to Charlotte, N.C., on Sunday, Nov. 8, at Spectrum Center. The Ally Tipoff brings together some of college basketball's biggest women's basketball teams for a doubleheader in the Queen City. At 3:00 p.m., No. 25 N.C. State University will take on No. 14 Kentucky, followed by No.1 South Carolina taking on No. 12 North Carolina at 5:30 p.m.
Dave Wehner, Meta’s chief strategy officer, is leaving the company to become CFO of Fireworks, the AI infrastructure startup valued at $17.5 billion in July.

The Badgers are expected to give quarterback Ryan Hopkins his first start Nov. 7 against Rutgers. Here is the lowdown on the freshman. Last year, Carter Smith was forced into action due to a stream of injuries, coming off the bench in an upset win over Washington and then starting the final three games of the season. On Nov. 7, it will be Ryan Hopkins' turn. Hopkins is expected to make his first start , allowing him to join Smith and Jay Macias as the only true freshman quarterbacks to start for the Badgers since 1991.

Damara Allen scored 17 points, but UTSA otherwise struggled to get rolling on offense in a loss at UNLV to begin the 2026-27 season. Allen was the only Roadrunners player to score in double figures, hitting 5 of 13 shots for a UTSA team that shot just 26.7% with 21 turnovers. The Lady Rebels used a 10-0 run in the second quarter to take a 27-21 lead into halftime, then scored the first seven points of the third quarter to stretch the margin. UNLV led by as many as 22 points down the stretch. This article originally published at UTSA women drop season opener at UNLV despite Damara Allen's career high .

Jordan Elliott is set to work out for the Chicago Bears following his release from the Tennessee Titans in October. While he didn't get into the specifics of the incident, he reminded everyone that he views Elliott as a good man who, in a moment, had a terrible lapse in judgment that was more a cry for help than a criminal act, and doubled down by stating he would vouch for Elliott if any organization wanted to take a chance on the defensive tackle. Next week, he may get that chance. In a post on X (formerly Twitter), NFL Insider Jordan Schultz reports that Elliott will work out with the Chicago Bears next week.

According to insider Aaron Wilson, ex-Chiefs RB Dameon Pierce is garnering significant interest ahead of the NFL trade deadline. Per Wilson's reporting, Pierce — who was released by the Philadelphia on November 6 with an injury settlement — has already received calls from the Miami Dolphins , Jacksonville Jaguars , Carolina Panthers , Baltimore Ravens , Arizona Cardinals , Tennessee Titans , and San Francisco 49ers. While Pierce is said to be dealing with a "relatively minor" hamstring issue, his injury status isn't keeping running-back-needy teams from pursuing the former Florida Gator.

It took two games for UCLA freshman Nikola Kusturica to break out at the NCAA level. Kusturica scored 29 points in the win. Kusturica had a first half out of a dream, not missing a single shot and outscoring North Florida by himself in a very impressive breakout game for UCLA 's 17-year old freshman. It wouldn't have mattered how old Kusturica was, as Friday's performance would have been excellent if he was 23 but instead the Serbian is putting the NCAA on notice before turning 18. UCLA's star freshman ended the game with 29 points on a very tidy 10-12 shooting from the field. The Falcons face a brutal test against Cincinnati's elite receivers. Can Atlanta's battered secondary survive the Bengals' attack in Madrid? The Falcons have struggled to stop the pass all year, allowing roughly 271 yards per game. They now face perhaps the best receiver duo in the entire league. Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins combined for 296 yards and two touchdowns in their last game. Atlanta must find a way to slow them down or the offense will never get a chance to win. Kevin Stefanski knows the challenge is massive. "Having two wide receiver playmakers like they have, I don't know if anybody in the league has guys like that," Stefanski said, according to Blogging Dirty .

Follow our live CFP rankings predictions as Week 10 scores roll in and reshape the projected bracket, playoff race and biggest debates. Alabama landing at No. 5 was the eyebrow raiser , while Notre Dame (No. 11) and Ohio State (No. 12) got some reality checks. But as Irish coach Marcus Freeman said Saturday , "What we're ranked today, that has no (indication) of what it's going to be in a couple weeks and we learned that lesson last year. So don't worry about the rankings, right now. Worry about it at the end of the season."

On the latest episode of the " Deebo and Joe " podcast, both former stars acknowledged head coach Mike McCarthy's early success in adjusting scheme elements, fixing blocking gaps, and reviving a stagnant run game. Haden gave full credit to McCarthy's willingness to self-evaluate rather than stand on the status quo. Hull are four points above the relegation zone and are now winless across their past 15 meetings with Arsenal. Sergej Jakirovic's side competed with the champions for much of the match and had a chance to take the lead early on when Elliot Stroud's strike from a tight angle was well saved by David Raya. The visitors tried to push for a late leveller but Arsenal always looked comfortable after going in front. Hull may not have been able to replicate their shock 2-1 win at Arsenal from 2008, but this performance will at least give Jakirovic confidence his side can compete with the top flight's best.

Carolina adds Jakorian Bennett to the practice squad amid a severe cornerback injury crisis, with interim coordinator Todd Wash backing the remaining roster. The team is already without Jaycee Horn, Mike Jackson, and Akayleb Evans due to various injuries. Rookie Will Lee III has been sidelined all week with a hamstring issue and is likely to be ruled out of the upcoming matchup. Consequently, only Chau Smith-Wade and Malcolm DeWalt IV remain on the active roster as healthy corners prepared to play. Per Sporting News , the pass defense struggled significantly against the Green Bay Packers in the recent 27-19 loss, and the injury list is the primary reason for that breakdown.

Cornish Pirates joint-head coach Gavin Cattle says his side must learn from their surprise 33-19 loss at home to struggling Richmond. The London side put in an excellent performance as they came back from 19-7 down in the first quarter to get a bonus-point win. The loss sees Pirates slip to sixth in the Champ table while Richmond's second win of the season sees them move up to 10th place. "I thought both teams' intensity was pretty high, it was a physical game, and I think first of all you've got to credit Richmond for muscling up and sticking to it."

LOS ANGELES — After stacking losses and general uncompetitiveness, the Pittsburgh Penguins are facing the end of their 20-year competitive […] If not the obvious on-ice crumbling indicating that general manager Kyle Dubas has no choice but to pull the rip cord on the remnants of the Penguins dynasty, then the reality was confirmed by multiple reports rushed to print Friday. From Sportsnet's Elliotte Friedman indicating the moves could begin "pretty quickly," to radio host Mark Madden teasing Minnesota's interest in Evgeni Malkin .

Borussia Dortmund kept pace with Bayern Munich at the top of the Bundesliga table after overcoming Elversberg 2-1. Following the final whistle, Felix Nmecha reflected on a challenging afternoon for BV... "I think I struck the ball well twice today," Nmecha said with a laugh. "We knew Elversberg were a good footballing side, and they certainly didn't make things easy for us. In the end, you have to fight, that's what you have to do, and then you win." Asked about the ongoing title battle with Bayern Munich, Nmecha played down its significance at this stage of the season.
